items.text: Hey Team Principals,

With a new year having dawned upon us we've been working hard at the HQ to bring you a bunch of new features that let you take the wheel in what you do in F1® Manager 24. These features include a host of customisation options that allow you to create new Drivers, custom seasons and the race calendar. Manage your experience on the grid like never before and we can't wait to see what you do with these new customisation features!
Please find the full list of Update Notes below...

notes.title: Expanded customisation and season setup options, including

items.text: Edit all 10 teams' driver and staff lineups
Set all 10 teams' starting balance
Set all 10 teams' facilities and car performance starting levels
Take control of any team in Create-A-Team mode
Create your own drivers and staff
Set their biographical info and staff attributes
Adjust the race calendar at the start of a new save
Move or remove (to a minimum of 8) races in the schedule
Choose which races have a sprint weekend
Adjust the rules and regulations, including points allocations schemes
Optionally randomise the race calendar between seasons for a renewed challenge
Enhanced the simulation of rubber on track and grip levels – and the impact on lap times – during and across qualifying sessions
OVR rating adjustments made to some young drivers (new saves only)
Generated and created drivers and staff now represented with a nationality
Custom teams can now be given a nationality
Various stability & performance improvements

Resolved inability to see which are active sponsors in decal editor
Welcome Email will no longer display incorrect contract data having started Create A Team game with vacant seats
Breakout multiplier lower limit set to x0.5

Addressed blank response when offering a contract with an immediate deadline on first day of race weekend
Revised UI in contract negotiation screen
Resolved starting balance not updating when changing engine manufacturer during End of Season flow
Addressed some Engagement Activities not contributing to the Engagement Target after the first season

Resolved Spending Breakdown screen not displaying any Incoming or Outgoing data for Sponsors

"Biggest Issue" feedback will no longer show an incorrect number of staff with same opinion

Stroll & Bottas grid positions
Tyre allocations
Season performance data
Various localisation improvements

Updated dialogue text for Theo Pourchaire to remove a grammar mistake

Hey Team Principals!

As we head into Abu Dhabi and the exciting conclusion of the Formula 1 World Championship, we're lifting the covers off Hotfix 1.10 which includes changes to Powertrain Payments, Contracts and Pit Lane Starts.
Please keep sharing your feedback and any issues observed with us in the Issue Tracker.
Full patch notes below....
Pit Lane Starts
Fixed pit lane start persisting across sessions after breaking Parc Ferme multiple times within the same session
Fixed the blank driver panel after breaking Parc Ferme during Q2
Removed the possibility of continuing to Q2 after breaking Parc Ferme in Q1
Powertrain Payments
Fixed powertrain costs continuing to be paid annually rather than monthly
Fixed incorrect 'Starting Balance' values not matching the End of Season flow
Contracts & Hiring
Fixed costs to break contract being charged for contract renewals
Improved contract negotiation UI to display more relevant information in the 'Current Contract' panel
Fixed the incorrect order of items in Contract Proposals
Race Weekend
Fixed fastest lap being awarded to driver finishing P11
Fixed cars not returning to pits when managing Qualifying
Hey Team Principals!
We hope that, like us, you've been enjoying a thrilling 2024 Formula One season so far.

Back at HQ, we've been hard at work on a significant upgrade package to take you to the front of the grid as we head towards Abu Dhabi. Update 1.9 contains a host of new features designed to enhance the realism and expand upon the information gathering and the endless drive for progress which is critical in ensuring teams make the right calls to take them to the top.
Alongside these new features, this update also contains a substantial suite of rebalancing and fixes!
Learn more about the new features in our recent blog post
Pit lane starts now fully supported for player and AI teams based on real-world regulations
Principals will be prompted before making a change that break Parc fermé rules and incur a pit lane start
Principals can now focus drivers into three new distinct areas of development in order to use their skills to benefit your team
This is also applicable to affiliate drivers, giving extra reason and purpose to make use of affiliate positions
Added new "Team Suitability" rating uncovered when scouting staff and drivers to help inform hiring decisions
The rating consider a variety of factors and results are dynamic dependent on the context
Added new email content providing insight into negotiations and hiring happening elsewhere on the grid

Hey folks,
Thank you for bearing with us while we've been looking into the issues you have reported with F1 Manager 24.
We were hopeful to get a patch out this week, however some of the issues have required more time than first anticipated to work through.
Unfortunately, this means we won't be able to get an update out to you until early next week. This patch will resolve the following issues amongst others:
Contract counter offers never being received
AI developing the same car parts through the season
Instances of incorrectly applied grid penalties when changing powertrain parts

A crash when randomising team branding elements
UI error may occur when editing sponsor placement
UI softlock may occur when selecting car part via rules and regulations screen
Grid penalty incorrectly applied after changing powertrain parts
Team comms may incorrectly reference traffic during qualifying
